node.label: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 10
node.definition: A rare condition that affects the nervous system. Signs and symptoms of the condition can develop any time from birth to adulthood and may include progressive dementia, seizures, lack of muscle coordination, and vision loss. CLN10-NCL is caused by changes (mutations) in the CTSD gene and is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. Treatment options are limited to therapies that can help relieve some of the symptoms.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
